en: An old sepia-toned image depicting a stretch of sandy beach bordered by vegetation on the right. A few people are dispersed along the shoreline, and there are piers or jetty-like structures extending into the water. In the background, there are several large buildings atop a low rise, and ships are visible in the distance, suggesting an active harbor or port area. There is a number '750' handwritten in the upper right corner.
